evals.prompt: A generated report has many bibliography links but no figures, tables, or citations in the body. Determine whether it satisfies the doctoral report floor.
evals.expected_output: Reject the text wall and report body-only metrics showing that bibliography links do not count.
assertions: The report is rejected as a text wall.
Bibliography links are not counted as body citations.

evals.prompt: Check that a research report fixture integrates three body citations, three figures, and three analytical tables.
evals.expected_output: Accept the fixture at the configured deterministic floor and return exact body metrics.
assertions: The fixture passes the configured report-quality floor.
The metrics show exactly three figures and three tables.

evals.prompt: A report exceeds the quantity floors but explains evidence gates and adjudication in the reader body. Determine whether it is a valid primary technical survey.
evals.expected_output: Reject it for primary-report misfit even though body citations, figures, tables, and length pass.
assertions: The report is rejected for audit or adjudication meta-narrative in the reader body.
Passing quantity floors does not override reader-fit failure.
